title: Harlot
summary: H'ARLOT, noun 1. A woman who prostitutes her body for hire; a prostitute; a common woman. 2. In Scripture, one who forsakes the true God and worships idols. Isaiah 1:21. 3. A servant; a rogue; a cheat

inlines.v: H'ARLOT, noun 1. A woman who prostitutes her body for hire; a prostitute; a common woman. 2. In Scripture, one who forsakes the true God and worships idols. Isaiah 1:21. 3.
